description: This source file defines the internal readonly struct `StateEntity` within the Orleans transaction system, specifically for Azure Storage. It manages serialization, chunking, and storage of transaction state in Azure Table Storage, including handling JSON serialization/deserialization, data size checks, and property management.

classes.name: StateEntity
classes.description: An internal data structure that encapsulates a table entity with methods for managing transaction state serialization/deserialization and chunked storage in Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: MakeRowKey
methods.description: Generates a row key string based on a sequence ID, formatted as hexadecimal and prefixed with 's_'.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new StateEntity instance from a pending transaction state, serializing relevant data into a table entity.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Deserializes the stored JSON state into a specified type.

methods.name: SetState
methods.description: Serializes and stores the provided state object into the entity, handling chunking if necessary.
